Jordan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on GPU supply & regional autoscale. Two asks from PMs: 1) what does 'supply hedge' mean in practice, and 2) what customer-visible changes should we expect if procurement slips by 2-4 weeks?

Iris: Supply hedge = hybrid sourcing strategy + software fallbacks. Practically: mix of reserved racks, short-term lease, spot/market capacity, and extra prewarm lanes. Software fallbacks include routing to quantized variants, smaller batches, and prioritized routing for reserved customers.

Mateo: For a 2-4 week procurement slip, expect three phases of user impact: immediate short spikes handled by prewarm (negligible UX change), medium spikes handled by soft-failover to quantized variants (+~50-200ms p99), and prolonged pressure leading to cross-region routing or burst-bucket remapping (+~100-400ms depending on distance). We'll avoid model-quality regressions by preferring fidelity-validated quantized models first.

Priya: CS asks: can we get a bulleted list of which customers are in burst-buckets vs prewarm-eligible vs on-demand only? They need this for proactive outreach.

Mateo: There's a tagging export available in console -> infra -> capacity-tags. I can run the export and share. It includes customer_id, tag (reserved_bucket/prewarm_eligible), and SLA tier.

Jordan: Can someone drop the quick ops playbook snippet here so PMs can paste it into customer comms?

Iris: Short runbook snippet below, full runbook linked in Confluence.
```
# ops quick snippet
if region.prewarm_headroom < 15%:
  notify(#infra-oncall)
  enable_quantized_routing(timeout=3m)
  reduce_batch_size(customers=prewarm_eligible)
  if sustained(duration>=10m):
    remap_burst_buckets()
    consider_cross_region_failover(window=30m)
```

CapacityBot: Runbook created: https://confluence.redwood/infra/supply-hedge-fallbacks :white_check_mark:

Priya: Helpful. Timeline ask: how soon will APAC and EMEA prewarm lanes be available? Leadership mentioned ramping in phases but PMs want dates to set expectations.

Mateo: ETA: EMEA phased prewarm in mid-May (pending validation), APAC targeted end of June. These are contingent on rack delivery and smoke tests. If any delivery slips by >2 weeks, we'll start routing more aggressively to quantized variants earlier to protect latency SLOs.

Jordan: One last thing 1  can we get a short customer-facing blurb we can copy into status updates?

Iris: Copy for status: "We're proactively hedging GPU supply to reduce impact from procurement delays. In the unlikely event of capacity constraints, we'll route traffic to optimized model variants and nearby capacity to keep services responsive. You may see small, temporary increases in latency; reserved customers and burst-bucket customers will be prioritized. See details: https://confluence.redwood/infra/supply-hedge-fallbacks."

Jordan: Great, thanks all. Action items: Mateo to export capacity-tags CSV and share with CS by EOD; Iris to update the one-page customer blurb and link to runbook; Priya to prepare a draft outreach for high-risk customers. I'll sync with Support after those artifacts are in place. :thumbsup:
